```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .aac-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .aac-header {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 28% 1fr 1fr;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    gap: 0;
  }

  .aac-header-cell {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .aac-header-cell:not(:first-child) {
    padding-left: 16px;
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.25);
  }

  .aac-header-icon {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .aac-header-icon svg {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .aac-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 28% 1fr 1fr;
    align-items: stretch;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .aac-row:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }

  .aac-attr {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .aac-row:hover .aac-attr { background: #E6E5F4; }

  .aac-attr-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .aac-row:hover .aac-attr-icon { background: #F8F7F0; }

  .aac-attr-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .aac-attr-name {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .aac-cell {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 0.92em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.5;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .aac-cell:last-child { border-right: none; }

  .aac-cell.aac-examples {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    align-content: center;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .aac-chip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 4px 10px 4px 4px;
    border: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #564232;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .aac-chip-badge {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  @media (max-width: 560px) {
    .aac-header { display: none; }
    .aac-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .aac-attr { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; }
    .aac-cell {
      border-right: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .aac-cell:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .aac-cell::before {
      content: attr(data-label);
      font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.72em;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: #5654A2;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .aac-cell.aac-examples {
      flex-direction: row;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .aac-cell.aac-examples::before {
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: -2px;
    }
  }
</style>

<div class="aac-outer">
```
